note: Johnson County NE has county zoning (zoning manual; Official Zoning Map dated 2006, published only as a map in the manual). The county's only GIS is the gWorks parcel viewer (johnson.gworks.com), which exposes no public ArcGIS REST service (/arcgis/rest/services returns 404). No zoning district polygon service found in ArcGIS Hub/Online or the web search. Cities (Tecumseh, Cook, Sterling, Crab Orchard) publish no zoning GIS found.
